newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish LOT, oil refinery set up fuel firm.
newsitem.headline: Polish LOT, oil refinery set up fuel firm.

text.p: Poland's national airline PLL LOT and the country's biggest oil refinery Petrochemia Plock SA on Monday set up a firm to deliver fuel to planes at Warsaw's Okecie airport.

The creation of the new firm, Petrolot sp z o.o., is a step in LOT's restructuring ahead of its privatisation, likely to start next year, Transport Minister Boguslaw Liberadzki said after a signing ceremony.

The company, in which Petrochemia has a 51-percent stake and LOT 49 percent, will allow the air carrier, so far solely responsible for fuels distribution at Okecie, to cut costs and focus on its core business.
"The new firm may help transform Warsaw Okecie into hub, where one stocks up on fuel," Liberadzki said.
The company, with a 20 million zloty capital, is forecast to have sales of $40 million in the first year of operations.
